status: Private component. Shared registration and installed qualification are pending.

native_scope.image: Plain canonical C-contiguous native-endian aligned ndarray of float64, float32 or uint8 with verified backing. Both axes are at least two, with up to 131072 elements.
native_scope.level: Explicit finite exact Python float or ordinary int level. Native default midpoint applies to float64 only. Finite values and explicit level are bounded by 2^40 in magnitude under round-to-nearest.
native_scope.mask: None or a plain matching canonical C-contiguous bool ndarray with bounded backing.
native_scope.order: Row-major marching squares. Strict comparisons, binary64 edge interpolation, ordered ambiguous segments, and first-created contour identity on splice. Exact endpoint equality skips a degenerate segment.
native_scope.ownership: A list of independent writable float64 arrays. Low orientation has owning C-order contours; high orientation returns ordinary reversed ndarray views of their respective owners.
native_scope.parallelism: Serial kernel, with the same native path in normal and runtime-forced-scalar modes.
native_scope.compatibility: Other objects, layouts, descriptors, floating extremes, NaN/Inf, rounding and missing default precision domains are passed to the established compatibility path. Raw floating environment equivalence is pending.

timing.boundary: Whole public call including response allocation, contour path materialization and orientation view.
